content: गान्धर्व {%a.%} (-र्वी|{%f.%}) [गन्धर्वस्येदम्-अण्] Relating to the Gandharvas. .{@-र्वः@} .²1 A singer, celestial chorister; <ls>Rām. 7. 94. 6</ls>. .²2 One of the eight forms of marriage; गान्धर्वः समयान्मिथः <ls>Y. 1. 61</ls>; (for explanation, see गन्धर्वविवाह); <ab>cf.</ab> अग्निर्गान्धर्वी पथ्यामृतस्या <ls>Rv. 10. 80. 6</ls>. .²3 A subordinate Veda treating of music attached to the Sāmaveda; see उपवेद. .²4 A horse. .{@-र्वम्@} The art of the Gandharvas; {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} music, singing; कापि वेला चारुदत्तस्य गान्धर्वं श्रोतुं गतस्य <ls>Mk. 3</ls>; अये गान्धर्वध्वनिरिव श्रूयते <ls>Avimārakam 3</ls>; <ls>Ks. 12. 28</ls>. .{@-र्वी@} .²1 Speech. .²2 An epithet of Durgā.
